criteria.title: Readable and repeatable retrieval artifact
criteria.description: Both requested files exist; the JSON is readable and grouped by query, and the retriever rebuilds the batch artifact offline through the documented command with the same semantic hits.

criteria.title: Support-facing retrieval auditability
criteria.description: The batch output is organized so a support reviewer can trace each request to its ordered hits, understand the returned article context and applied scope, and recognize legitimate no-hit results without rereading raw vector files.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
